summary: ROUND 3 testing completed. Focused on user stories NOT tested in rounds 1 & 2. Successfully tested: STORY J (booking lookup without token), STORY K (empty state for full dates), public pages regression. CRITICAL FINDING: Booking form datetime-local inputs not accepting programmatic values correctly - dates revert to defaults. This blocks full E2E testing of STORIES A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I via UI. Backend APIs working correctly (verified via API calls). Created test booking BK-0067 via API for testing other flows.

critical_bugs.issue: datetime-local inputs not accepting programmatic values - dates revert to default/previous values instead of using filled values
critical_bugs.impact: BLOCKS automated E2E testing of booking flow. Manual testing works, but Playwright fill() and JavaScript value setting both fail to update React state properly
critical_bugs.reproduction: 1. Fill input[name='start'] with '2026-10-15T08:00' via JavaScript or Playwright fill(). 2. Submit form. 3. Observe search uses different dates (e.g., Aug 12, 2026 instead of Oct 15)
critical_bugs.workaround: Use API to create bookings for testing, or test manually
critical_bugs.note: This is a React controlled component issue - the input value changes but the React state doesn't update, so form submission uses stale state
